event_chain.summary: Arithmetic bug exploited to mint yETH

summary: On November 30, 2025 an attacker exploited an unchecked arithmetic bug and related design flaws in Yearn Finance's legacy yETH stableswap pool to mint a near-infinite amount of yETH (2.35x10^56 tokens) and use it to drain liquidity from the yETH pool and a smaller yETH-WETH Curve pool. Total losses approached $9 million; Yearn recovered about $2.4 million. It was the third attack on Yearn since 2021.
